drugs.name: Donepezil
drugs.mechanism: Reversible acetylcholinesterase inhibitor that increases cholinergic neurotransmission.
drugs.efficacy: Symptomatic improvement in mild-to-severe Alzheimer's dementia cognitive scoring.
drugs.disease_evidence: First-line symptomatic therapy for Alzheimer's disease.

drugs.name: Memantine
drugs.mechanism: Uncompetitive low-affinity NMDA receptor antagonist protecting against glutamate-induced excitotoxicity.
drugs.efficacy: Modest cognitive and functional stabilization in moderate-to-severe AD.
drugs.disease_evidence: Approved standard-of-care for moderate-to-severe Alzheimer's disease.

drugs.name: Lecanemab
drugs.mechanism: Humanized IgG1 monoclonal antibody binding soluble Abeta protofibrils to clear brain amyloid deposits.
drugs.efficacy: Slows cognitive decline on CDR-SB by 27% at 18 months in early AD.
drugs.disease_evidence: Disease-modifying biologic targeting amyloid plaques in early AD.

drugs.name: Donanemab
drugs.mechanism: Monoclonal antibody targeting N3pG-Abeta (pyroglutamate-modified amyloid) to eliminate established plaques.
drugs.efficacy: Significant reduction in cognitive decline (35% slowing) on iADRS scale.
drugs.disease_evidence: Plaque-clearing biologic approved for early symptomatic Alzheimer's.

drugs.name: Rivastigmine
drugs.mechanism: Dual pseudo-irreversible inhibitor of acetylcholinesterase and butyrylcholinesterase.
drugs.efficacy: Provides symptomatic benefit in mild-to-moderate AD.

drugs.name: Galantamine
drugs.mechanism: Competitive acetylcholinesterase inhibitor and allosteric modulator of nicotinic acetylcholine receptors.
drugs.efficacy: Symptomatic cognitive enhancement in mild-to-moderate AD.
